_comment: THE one portrait of each hero (the user, 2026-10-25: 'consolida tudo em um só retrato'). Every screen draws a hero from here and nowhere else: world map (party panel, Party menu, class path, conversations, formation), battle bar, status sheet, dialogs. file = under the art folder (content/assets).
